test_title: PYST 55: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom.

Sanchit stands by his friends __through thick and thin__.
solution:
The correct answer is Option (4) i.e.** 'Under all circumstances'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **Through thick and thin **means: In both good times and bad times (हर परिस्थिति में)

 
 
• **Example**: She has supported me **through thick and thin**.
 
 
 
• **Under all circumstances: **(हर स्थिति में) - Regardless of the situation or difficulty.
 
• This option directly reflects the idiom's meaning related to **unwavering support or allegiance in every situation.**

Therefore, the correct answer is **'Under all circumstances'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **In winter and summer:** Literal seasons, not related to the abstract meaning of support and loyalty conveyed by the idiom.
 
• **In favourable situations:** (अनुकूल स्थितियों में) - Only when things are going well, which does not fully capture the idiom's encompassing intent.
 
• **In crowded areas: **(भीड़-भाड़ वाले क्षेत्रों में) - A literal physical space, unrelated to the concept of enduring support implied by the idiom.

54:T85f,

The correct answer is Option (4) i.e. **'Mendicant'.**
